import json, os
releases=[]
for r in range(8):
    motifs=[[1515 + 20*((i >> (j % 9)) & 1) for j in range(16)] for i in range(256)]
    disc=[]
    for m in motifs:
        for _ in range(2):
            disc.append({'class':0,'values':[0]*24+list(m)+[0]*24,'activation':[0]*24+[100]*16+[0]*24})
    validation=[{'class':0,'values':[m for motif in motifs for m in motif][:128]} for _ in range(64)]
    train=[{'class':0,'values':[1515]*16} for _ in range(1024)]
    releases.append({'id':'b%d'%r,'classes':1,'width':16,'eps':[1,1000],'ratio':[1,256],
        'threshold':[0,1],'mode':'exact','packet_limit':200000,'idle_us':10**12,
        'discovery':disc,'train':train,'validation':validation})
blocks=[[['install','b0']]]; ops=1
nflow=8192; pk=24; extra=3392
for f in range(nflow):
    fid='f%d' % f
    block=[['open',fid]]; ops+=1
    ts=0
    for p in range(pk + (1 if f<extra else 0)):
        block.append(['packet',fid,ts,0,300+p%50]); ts+=1; ops+=1
    block.append(['close',fid]); ops+=1
    blocks.append(block)
while ops<218432:
    blocks[-1].append(['install','b0']); ops+=1
req={'capacity':{'range':4096,'exact':8192},'releases':releases,'blocks':blocks}
open('/tmp/big.json','w').write(json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':')))
print('bytes', os.path.getsize('/tmp/big.json'))
